phase_classifier.boundary_note: These broad phase labels are contextual bins, not fitted transition temperatures.

linewidth_table: adjacent difference divided by combined reported uncertainty
phase_linewidth_summary: inverse-variance weighted mean when positive uncertainties are available
published_dho_fit_curve_diagnostic: interpolate the authors' published fit curve onto source data energies within the fit energy range
RMS standardized residual using source S(Q,E) errors where error > 0

dho_license_before_execution.reason: FIG4 sheet 4b tabulates temperature, DHO-derived linewidth and linewidth uncertainty only. FIG4 sheet 4a supplies measured spectra and published fit curves but does not tabulate same-condition omega0. The parser contract forbids back-fitting omega0 from those curves without a separately frozen fit contract.
dho_license_before_execution.linewidth_symbol_context: The published figure caption identifies the quantity as Gamma_LW extracted from DHO fits. It is retained as a native linewidth observable and is not automatically equated to the damping coefficient required by chi_DHO.
